reason: A DSH development and runtime-management plugin for injecting local plugin packages into a running web process, with hot reload, staging, promotion, unloading, persistence, and related scaffolding and build tools.

summaries.zh: 用于在运行中的 DSH Web 进程中注入、热重载、测试、转正和卸载本地插件包，并提供插件开发辅助工具。
summaries.en: A DSH development utility for injecting, hot-reloading, testing, promoting, and unloading local plugin packages in a running web process.

capabilities: Loads and injects arbitrary local DSH plugin packages into a running web process
Hot-reloads, unloads, stages, promotes, and restores plugins
Creates junction links and persists plugin registry data on the local filesystem
Modifies runtime routes and client plugin state
